children.value: > Fact From Story: Taylor Swift has revealed when her relationship with Travis Kelce really started.
> > Fact From Story: Swift also confirmed that when she famously first attended Kelce’s game at Arrowhead Stadium in September, she was already dating the NFL star.

> > > Fact From Story: She said she connected with Kelce in July, after he confessed on his podcast that he tried and failed to give her a friendship bracelet with his phone number on it during one of her Eras Tour shows.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: July comes before September.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Arrowhead Stadium is the home stadium of the Kansas City Chiefs.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When two people are in a relationship, they are dating.
